description.value: Poké Aye is a Hawaiian-cuisine restaurant in Langford (Greater Victoria), specializing in poke bowls. Located in a unit-numbered commercial space (Unit 103), it sits in the western suburban corridor popular with cyclists commuting or touring between Langford and Victoria. The restaurant's name and Facebook branding are consistent with a contemporary, counter-service poke concept.
